decisions.reason: Retaining the client-supplied cover does not change the manuscript text, accepted edits, or authoritative working file.
KDP upload assistance is independently introduced by another clause of the same message; the cover preference does not modify that assistance requirement.
The selected cover visual does not alter the required back matter or author lines.
The cover preference does not change the requested guidance about publication processes or prerequisites.
The source selects the paperback cover visual but does not change the placement, coverage, or presentation of chapter illustrations.
The candidate governs suitability review for chapter illustrations, while the source decision concerns the separate cover image.
Retaining the supplied cover does not change the copyright-page publication attribution line.
The cover visual decision does not alter Chapter 18 typography or chapter-heading consistency.
The paperback format and 6 x 9 inch trim size remain unchanged by the choice to retain the supplied cover.
The source does not change the rendering-quality constraints for chapter illustrations.
The cover preference does not change manuscript copyediting, sentence clarity, or meaning-preservation requirements.
The cover visual decision does not affect pagination or the timing and accuracy of table-of-contents page-number updates.
